Dialogs.Dialog: Takane
Hey, what does it mean to be in a relationship, I wonder？
What's this, all of a sudden？
Well... since we started dating, I've changed, but I was wondering about you. Because it's frustrating if it's only me.
▲高嶺＊＊▲ is ▲高嶺＊＊▲. I don't think I've changed either.
Huh？
You've been kind and beautiful ever since we first met.
...Geez, that's unfair. ...But thank you. That's better than being told I've changed.
I see. Then, what about me？
Geez, you're making me say it？ ...You haven't changed either. Always wonderful.
You heard me just fine... Geez, hmph.
(I wanted to hear it again. No luck, huh.)
Takane
You know？ I was talking with friends before. About what being in a relationship means.
What it means？ ...Hmm.
Everyone groaned just like that. We said it's hard to put into words.
Could be. So, did you find an answer？
Yes. It's just my own answer, though. ...Being the closest one to the person you love.
Being closer to you than anyone else. That's what it is... I think.
...And then everyone teased me.
Whoa！ You told everyone that？
Y-Yes. But I asked them to forget it right away, so it's fine...
(There's no way that's fine...)
What does dating mean, I wonder？
Takane
What's wrong, with that serious face？ Okay, I'll think about it with you.
Hmm... maybe it means having you all to myself？
I see, so we get to have each other all to ourselves.
Hmm, I wonder about that？
Huh, that's not it!?
...Just kidding.
Manaka will always be yours▼
(Phew...)
What do girls usually think about？
Takane
What's wrong？ All of a sudden.
I'm just a little curious.
Hmm... What about boys？
That's... well...
... Pervert.
Huh!? I didn't say anything！
Geez, I'm kidding. Don't panic like that？
(When did ▲高嶺＊＊▲ learn tricks like this...)
Hey, what do girls think about？
Takane
What's wrong？ Did something... happen？
The other day, a girl started crying in the middle of class.
I wonder if something sad happened...？
Who knows. By break time she was fine again... I just don't get it.
I see... But that's worrying.
That's worrying too, but for me, I was more curious whether that ever happens to you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Me？ I'll probably be fine. Even if I suddenly feel sad... I've got... you know？
Huh？
Hm？
...Yeah！ I think I'll be fine after all.
What do girls usually think about？
Takane
Girls？ Not me？ ...Is there a girl you're interested in？
No, no！ That's not it！
...Hehe！
Sorry. I think about you so much that I wanted to tease you like that.
The answer to your question... Is that good？
It's good！
▲高嶺＊＊▲？ Your face is a little red, are you okay？
Takane
Yes, my heart's pounding.
Maybe you have a fever... Let me feel your forehead――
Eek！
What's wrong？
You're the cause of my heart pounding.
Did I do something？
No. Sometimes when I think of you... This is what happens.
It usually happens when I'm alone. But sometimes when I look at your face... Hey, how do I make it stop？
(Part of me wants it to stop, and part of me doesn't...)
When does your heart race, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Takane
Heart race？ Let's see...
When our eyes meet at school... I think.
Me？
Yes. I spot you far away, and then you notice me. And then our eyes meet, right？
That's when my heart races... And then you smile at me a little... I really love that.
Huh？
...I said it. Forget that, okay？
(No way I can do that！)
Takane
Hey, do you know what the suspension bridge effect is？
That thing where your brain mistakes the fear of crossing a suspension bridge for the thrill of love？
Right. But I wonder if love is so simple that you could fall in love with someone based on that.
If it's true, that's a little disappointing.
Yes, me too. I want it to be something more sacred.
When I first saw you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲, my heart was pounding...
...Really？
Of course. What about you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Not just the first time...
Huh？
Even now, when our eyes meet, my heart suddenly jumps. I want love to be something wonderful like this...
Takane
Don't you feel like time goes by fast when we're together？
Yeah, sometimes it feels like it's over in a flash.
Yes. So I thought about why.
That's ▲高嶺＊＊▲ for you！ Tell me.
Elementary, my dear Watson. Maybe it's because our hearts are always racing when we're together.
A racing heart means a high heart rate. Animals with fast heart rates, like mice, have short lifespans, right？ So when we're together, time really flows faster than usual.
Haha, interesting hypothesis.
So if time feels short, our hearts are racing... which means we're close. Right？
I see. Then I guess time feeling short can't be helped. A little sad, though.
Takane
*Sigh*...
What's wrong？
No, nothing. I'm fine. It's just... your scent...
Huh, mine？
Yes... When we're together, if I suddenly notice your scent, my heart starts racing...
You always smell nice, ▲高嶺＊＊▲, but... my smell？
I like it.
Well, then I guess it's fine. Here, sniff all you want！
Eek！ Geez, don't make me sound like a puppy.
Haha, sorry, sorry.
Huh？ The surprise seems to have stopped my heart racing.
(...Like hiccups.)
Takane
The other day, my heart was really racing.
Oh, what happened？
Because you were talking with another girl.
Eh!?
You looked like you were having so much fun...
It's a misunderstanding！
I know. I'm just being jealous on my own. But...
...But？
If you make me too jealous, I might make your heart race in return？
You, getting close to other guys, ▲高嶺＊＊▲... I don't need that kind of heart racing！
Okay～.
Takane
Lately, my friends keep asking if my taste in fashion has changed.
Really... You seem happy about it？
Yes. I never cared that much about fashion before... so being told I've changed feels new.
I see. I liked how you were when we met too, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Thank you. But I want you to see all different sides of me... Just saying.
Hehe, so be ready！
(It's amazing that ▲高嶺＊＊▲ would change for me.)
Takane
The other day, I forgot my phone at home and had to rush back to get it.
Haha, so even you forget things, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Geez, don't tease me. And so, on my way back, I suddenly realized...
Realized what？
That before I started dating you, I probably would've just gone out without it.
You, before you started dating me, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Yes. I'd have thought one day without a phone is fine. But that time, I went straight back without even thinking. ...Because I'm waiting for messages from you.
I see. Thanks.
No... I should thank you. Feeling that I've changed through a little thing like this is wonderful. It's all thanks to you.
Hehe, so send me lots of texts and calls！ Okay？
All right, got it！
Takane
Since I started dating you, people have started telling me...
Huh, telling you what？
That I've gotten gentler.
Is that so...？ Haven't you always been？
Thank you. But people I hadn't seen in a while, and even my family, said it... I don't feel it myself.
So I'm the only one who didn't notice...
Yes, that's the problem. Why only you...？
Why, I wonder？
Geez, think properly？
......Hmm, nope. I give up.
Probably because I talk to you about all sorts of things, right？ So... you're in it with me. You're one of the people who changed me.
So, because we're both thinking about the same things？
Yes. So maybe the me of now is a joint work by you and me？
Takane
Lately, people often ask me for directions, or little kids suddenly talk to me.
Sure, you'd give good directions, ▲高嶺＊＊▲, and kids would want to play with a pretty big sister.
Praising me that much won't get you anything.
Haha. But there are people who are just easy to talk to, right？ Like they give off a gentle aura.
Maybe that's another gift from dating you？ An aura... Actually, someone did say something like that.
Huh？
Someone I gave directions to the other day said I give off the aura of his lover from a past life.
No... no, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！ That's a pickup line！
Is... it？ I thought it'd be better for him to ask a police officer, so I took him to the police box...
(Phew... I can't take my eyes off ▲高嶺＊＊▲...)
Takane
Ah, sorry... a text. From Mama.
What does it say？
Yes. She's asking me to pick something up, and... "Say hello to the person next to you." Hehe.
The person next to you... me？
The only person next to me is you.
Right！
Yes. ...Before, it was always things like "Come home early" or "Where are you now？" But since I started dating you, she seems reassured.
I see... Then I'll live up to her expectations！
Hehe. Then, I'm in your hands.
(I'll see her home safely, Mrs. Takane！)
Takane
This is sudden, but can I ask you something？
Yeah, what？
Recently, my friends have been telling me I've gotten prettier...
Not just recently！
Geez, listen. And not just one friend, several.
It's kind of late for them to notice, honestly...
...But then there's no point.
Hm？
I really was working hard to get prettier.
Huh, then that's great. It means it worked.
But it's pointless if you don't notice！
(You did this... for me？ I see...)
Takane
Hey, do other couples catch your attention？
...Why？
Because sometimes on dates, I find myself noticing couples walking toward us.
Ah, maybe. Especially if they're our age.
For me, especially if the girl is cute, I wonder if you think she's cute too.
No way I'd think that. I'm more worried about what you think of the guy, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
It's only you for me, you know.
Same goes for me！
Hehe.
Haha.
Yeah, I won't worry about other couples anymore.
(Right！)
Takane
...Hey.
Hm？
Um...
What's up？
Are we... kissing... too much？
Whaa!?
It came up with my friends... She said they don't kiss every date, and um... they don't keep doing it for ages...
So I got a little worried... Is it better not to worry about it...
Yeah！ Other couples are other couples, we're us！
...Okay.
(I feel like worrying about it means losing...！)
Takane
Hey. We're closer than any other couple, right？
You bet！ Second to none.
Hehe. Right. But... you're awfully confident？
Sure am. What else is boyfriend power for！
Huh？
Never mind！
？ Okay？
(I'll keep charging ahead！)
Takane
I wonder how much time we've spent together...
Time？
Yes. See, even if we've been dating a year, the time we actually spent together is probably not even half, right？
True. At home... even in class, we're apart most of the day.
Right. But even when we can't be together, I'm thinking of you.
So I decided to think that even the time we can't see each other is still part of dating you.
Yeah. Rather than being together but thinking about different things, being apart but thinking about each other feels more like dating.
Yes, that's right. Hehe, I'm glad it's you.
Me too！
Takane
You know, someday... when I'm an old lady, will I be able to remember right now？
Right now？
Yes. Right now. Me saying something like this out of nowhere, you looking a little troubled... but still listening properly...
I don't want to forget... No matter how long we're together, no matter how small it is...
I see. Yeah, it's okay, you'll remember！
Really？
Yeah. Grandpa me will make you remember, even if I have to force it.
▲主人公＊▲. Yes！ Please do！
Leave it to me！
Takane
Do you think we're alike？
Huh, how so？
Not any one thing... A friend told me our vibes have gotten similar.
Really... I can't tell myself.
Right. But people often say couples who've been together a long time start to look alike... It made me a little happy.
Yeah, that's kind of nice.
And people often say dogs look like their owners too, right？
Huh？
Oh, you're starting to look like a cute puppy.
Whaa！
Want to go for a walk？
...Woof.
